line: Bitcoin drifting steady on calm funding and mild greed, while whales quietly moved coins off exchanges in a reversal of weeks-old selling pressure.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin +0.35% on the day, spot ETF net -54.9M USD (Oct 19, 2026), Fear & Greed 59 (greed), funding +0.0084% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: JPMorgan extended its JPM Coin dollar deposit token to Ethereum for institutional clients, enabling faster settlement on a public blockchain.
Nine companies including Broadcom and Verizon objected to trading on the SEC-approved OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, and Nasdaq opted out entirely.
BlackRock filed for a Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF offering downside protection and upside exposure, marking the firm's third bitcoin fund.
